title: Debating Ethical Dilemmas / Maalaalaa ethiin mootummaa fi suuraa qajeelfama
bridge: Afaan Oromo, maalaalaa ethiin mootummaa fi suuraa qajeelfama kan barbaachisa, amma afaan Ingiliffaa, barbaachisa suuraa qajeelfama hin jiru; barbaachisaa isaanii fi barbaachiisuu isaanii miti. Fakkeenya, 'no creo que sea correcto' jedhan 'I don't think it is right' (hin 'it be right') jedha. Hegaadan, 'should' fi 'would' kan barbaachisa fi kan qajeelfama afaan Isbaanichii guutan miti. Haala dhaabbataa afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti barbaachisaa qajeelfama fi barbaachisaa isaanii hin jiru.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti maalaalaa ethiin mootummaa fi suuraa qajeelfama kan barbaachisa, haa isiniif barbaachu: 1) 'I think/ believe/ feel' + barbaachisaa isaanii: 'I think that...' (barbaachisaa suuraa qajeelfama hin jiru). 2) Barbaachiisuu isaanii: 'should' (barbaachisaa), 'ought to' (barbaachisaa isaanii), 'must' (barbaachisaa isaanii), 'can't' (barbaachisaa isaanii), 'could' (barbaachisaa isaanii), 'would' (barbaachisaa isaanii). 3) Barbaachisaa fi barbaachisaa isaanii: 'I agree with... because...', 'I see your point, but...', 'That may be true, however...'. 4) Barbaachisaa isaanii kan qajeelfama: 'If we allowed... , then...' (barbaachisaa isaanii), 'If I were in that situation, I would...' (barbaachisaa isaanii). 5) Barbaachisaa isaanii: 'therefore', 'moreover', 'nevertheless', 'although'. Barbaachisaa qajeelfama fi barbaachisaa isaanii hin jiru ('I don't agree with nothing' hin kennu) fi barbaachisaa isaanii keessatti barbaachu: 'Not only is it unethical, but also...'.

concept_examples.text: I believe that animal testing is unethical because it causes unnecessary suffering.
concept_examples.translation: Innishee baasaa irra deebi’anii adabbi siqii hin jiru jedhani.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈænɪməl ˈtestɪŋ ɪz ʌnˈeθɪkəl bɪˈkɔːz ɪt ˈkɔːzɪz ʌnˈnesəseri ˈsʌfərɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: If I were in that situation, I would tell the truth, even if it was difficult.
concept_examples.translation: Maaliif kan qaba, haqaa keessatti hin kennin, gara fuulduraa keessan irraa ta’ee jedhani.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ɪn ðæt ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən, aɪ wʊd tɛl ðə truːθ, ˈiːvən ɪf ɪt wʌz ˈdɪfɪkəlt/

concept_examples.text: Some people argue that genetically modified crops are necessary to feed the world, but others disagree.
concept_examples.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko mirgaasaa jaalalaa irra deebi’anii adabbi siqii jiru jedhanii, namoonni tokko tokko gara mana hidhaman hin qabdu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt dʒəˈnetɪkli ˈmɒdɪfaɪd krɒps ɑːr ˈnesəseri tuː fiːd ðə wɜːrld, bʌt ˈʌðərz ˌdɪsəˈɡriː/

concept_examples.text: We shouldn't sacrifice privacy for security; both are essential.
concept_examples.translation: Fuulduraa fi amantii keessatti tokko ilaa ta’u hin dandeenye; lamaaniif tokko tokko siqii jiru.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈʃʊdnt ˈsækrɪfaɪs ˈpraɪvəsi fɔːr sɪˈkjʊrəti; boʊθ ɑːr ɪˈsenʃəl/

common_error.wrong: I don't think that it is not ethical to lie.
common_error.correct: I don't think it is ethical to lie.
common_error.correct_alt: I think it is unethical to lie.
common_error.explanation: Eegama keessaa kan qabna, afaan Isbaanichii keessatti barbaachisaa qajeelfama fi barbaachisaa isaanii hin jiru ('No creo que no sea ético'), laakin afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti barbaachisaa isaanii tokko ilaa ta’u dandeessa. Inni kennamuu keessatti, 'not' barbaachisaa isaanii keessatti qabuu fi barbaachisaa isaanii keessatti barbaachu (unethical).

examples.translation: Qajeelfama keessan, mirgaasaa irra deebi’anii adabbi siqii jiru jechuu.

examples.note: Barbaachisaa 'strongly' barbaachisaa isaanii keessatti haasa’u.

examples.note: Barbaachisaa kan qaba mirgaasaa irra deebi’anii adabbi siqii jiru jechuu.

examples.note: Barbaachisaa kan qaba mirgaasaa irra deebi’anii adabbi siqii jiru jechuu.

examples.translation: Mirgaasaa keessan irra deebi’anii adabbi siqii jiru jechuu, laakin, mirgaasaa keessan irra deebi’anii adabbi siqii jiru jechuu.

title: Strategic Language for Negotiations / Afaan Isaa-malii fi Suudhaaf Baay'ee
bridge: Afaan Oromo, tokko tokko waaqattarraatiin ‘haqimmamoo’, ‘dhukammamoo’ jechuun isaanii argachuu dandeessan, garuu afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘would’, ‘could’, ‘might’ jechuun isaanii fayyadamaa qabna. Afaan Oromo essuun haa ilaalanii akkaan deebii duubadhu, garuu afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘no’ jedhanii hojjetan qabaachuu qaba. ‘De acuerdo’ jedhamuun ‘I am agree’ jechuu miti; ‘agree’ jedhaa ho???eessan dha. ‘I agree’ jedhaa ho???eessan dha.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii B2 keessummaa suudhaaf baay'ee keessatti, ‘would’, ‘could’, ‘might’, ‘may’ jechuun isaanii fayyadamaa qabna. ‘I would suggest...’ kana ‘We could consider...’ jechuun isaanii ‘I want...’ kana ‘You must...’ jechuun isaanii miti. Suudhaaf baay'ee keessatti, ‘What if...’ kana ‘How about...’ jechuun isaanii gerund kana clause jechuun isaanii fayyadamaa qabna. Akkaan deebii duubadhuu kanatti, ‘I see your point, but...’ kana ‘I'm afraid that...’ jechuun isaanii fayyadamaa qabna. Suudhaaf baay'ee keessatti, ‘If... then...’ jechuun isaanii fayyadamaa qabna. ‘Agree’ jedhaa afaan Ingilizii keessatti ho???eessan dha, ‘I am agree’ jechuu miti; ‘I agree’ jedhaa ho???eessan dha.

concept_examples.text: I would suggest we postpone the deadline to next week.
concept_examples.translation: Haqimmamoo gaaffii kun ta'u malee guyyaa muraasaa irra deebi'aa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd səˈdʒɛst wi poʊstˈpoʊn ðə ˈdɛdlaɪn tu nɛkst wik/

concept_examples.phonetic: /wi kʊd kənˈsɪdər ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɪf ju ˈɪnkris ðə ˈɔrdər ˈvɑljum/

concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæt praɪs ɪz ə bɪt ˈhaɪər ðæn wi ɪkˈspɛktɪd/

common_error.correct: I agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.

common_error.explanation: Akka tokko tokko ‘estoy de acuerdo’ jedhuu afaan Isaa-malii keessatti ‘I am agree’ jechuu miti. ‘Agree’ jedhaa afaan Ingilizii keessatti ho???eessan dha, ‘to be’ jechuun isaanii miti. Akkaan deebii duubadhuu kanatti, ‘agree’ jedhaa ‘coincidir’ kana ‘estar de acuerdo’ jechuun isaanii fayyadamaa qabna, ‘be’ jechuun isaanii miti. ‘Completely’ kana ‘partially’ jechuun isaanii fayyadamaa qabna.

examples.note: Akkaan deebii duubadhuu kanatti, haqiin haqimmamoo tokko kan ta'e.

examples.note: ‘I'm afraid’ jedhaa ‘no’ jechuun isaanii fayyadamaa qabna, garuu ‘fear’ jechuun isaanii miti.

examples.translation: Haqiin haqimmamoo tokko kan ta'e, garuu haqiin haqimmamoo tokko kan ta'e.

title: Discussing Literature and Film / Sirnaaanchi fi Siinimoo mataa’uu
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, kitaabaa fi filimni hamma tokkoo qajeelfama kennu malee, 'I found it...' kana 'It struck me as...' jiraataa ta’u godhatama qabnu argama. Afaan Oromoo keessatti garuu, 'dhaga'u' akkasuma 'maluu' jedhu godhatama qabnu argama. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, sirnaa irra deebii qabuu akka 'a gripping novel' jedhaa ta’e malee, Afaan Oromoo keessatti sirnaa irra deebii qabuu akka 'sirnaa hojii ta’e' jedhaa ta’e. Fakkeenyaa tokkoo akkasiis: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, gaaffii sirnaa qajeelfama kennu malee, gaaffii amantii akka 'the protagonist discovers...' jedhaa ta’e malee, Afaan Oromoo keessatti gaaffii amantii akkasuma gaaffii sirnaa qajeelfama kennu godhaa ta’e.
rule: Sirnaaanchi fi siinimoo mataa’uu afaan Ingilizii keessatti B2 dhaabbataa godhataa malee, haa ta’u malee: 1) Hamma tokkoo qajeelfama kennu 'I found it + sirnaa' (I found it thought-provoking) akkasuma 'It struck me as + sirnaa' (It struck me as predictable) godhaa ta’e. 2) Sirnaa qajeelfama kennu gaaffii amantii akka 'The story follows a detective who uncovers a conspiracy' jedhaa ta’e. 3) Gaaffii amantii sirnaa qajeelfama kennu 'I read the book last year' jedhaa ta’e. 4) Sirnaa qajeelfama kennu 'unlike' akkasuma 'whereas' godhaa ta’e (Unlike the book, the film omits several key scenes). 'Based on' (The movie is based on a novel) godhuu malee dhiisee. Sirnaa irra deebii qabuu 'gripping', 'thought-provoking', 'predictable', 'far-fetched', 'moving' jedhamu malee dhiisee. 'Me pareció' akkasuma 'it seemed to me' jedhu godhuu malee dhiisee; 'I thought' akkasuma 'I found' godhaa ta’e.

title: Discussing Health and Science News / Mataa dhiibbaa fi seentii walqabsoo hundaa’e
bridge: Afaan Oromo, mana hidhaa haala dhiibbaa fi seentii walqabsoo hundaa’e kan hin kennu, garuu Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, lamaan ibsuudhaaf kennu ‘Present Perfect’ hin jiru (‘Researchers have found...’) lamaan ibsuudhaaf kennu ‘Simple Past’ hin jiru (‘The study showed...’). Afaan Ingiliffaa keessummaa kanarraa, moddaaliin ‘may’, ‘might’ fi ‘could’ hin jiru jechuun qorataa fi hojii kennuudha. Afaan Oromo, ‘puede’ fi hojii qajeelfama hin jiru. Hundaa’e tokkoo kanarraa, ‘however’ fi ‘although’ hin jiru jechuun ‘sin embargo’ fi ‘aunque’ hin jiran, garuu hojii qajeelfama hin jiru.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa B2 keessatti dhiibbaa fi seentii walqabsoo hundaa’e kennuuf, haala murtoo haa kennu: 1) Present Perfect lamaan ibsuudhaaf kennu: ‘Scientists have discovered a new vaccine’, Simple Past lamaan ibsuudhaaf kennu: ‘The study was published in 2020’. 2) Qabsoo ibsuudhaaf kennu: ‘The drug is being tested’. 3) Moddaaliin qorataa fi hojii kennuudha: ‘may’, ‘might’, ‘could’ hin jiru jechuun ‘This could lead to new treatments’. 4) Hundaa’e tokkoo kennuudha: ‘however’, ‘although’, ‘despite’ hin jiru jechuun ‘although + subject + verb’ fi ‘despite + noun/-ing’. 5) Qajeelfama dhiibbaa fi seentii walqabsoo hundaa’e: ‘evidence’, ‘findings’, ‘symptoms’, ‘treatment’, ‘effective’ vs. ‘efficient’. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, hojii qajeelfama hin jiru: ‘The patient whom the doctor treated...’. Cifaraan fi qooddootaa barbaachisaa qaba.

title: Discussing Political and Social Issues / Mata dhaabbata siyasaa fi sooraa
bridge: Afan Oromo, mana dhaabbata siyasaa qabu ("Waan tokko tokko qabaachu" jechuun) akka ta'e kan argisiisu akkas ummi. Afaan Ingilizii, "important", "essential" jechuun "vital" akkas akka qabuu kan danda'an, 'subjunctive mood' (foormaa baafacha keessaa) "that" hin qabne "It's important that we vote" jechuudha. Dhaabbi tokkoo qolee: Afaan Oromo "cuando" jechuun kan danda'an, kan arrgachuufi ("Cuando haya elecciones"), Afaan Ingilizii, "when" jechuun kan danda'an, "When there are elections" jechuudha. "Should" jechuun barbaachisaa hin qabne dhaga'aa.
rule: Mata dhaabbata siyasaa fi sooraa B2, 1) "subjunctive mood" "important", "essential", "vital", "necessary" jechuun kan danda'an "It's essential that the government act now" jechuudha. Foormaa keessummaa qabanii hundaa akkas ummi. 2) "when", "if" fi kondishenalii kan danda'an "When the election happens, we'll know the results" jechuudha. 3) "I strongly believe", "I'm afraid I disagree", "that's a valid point, but..." jechuun kan danda'an. 4) "though" jechuun kan danda'an "The policy seems good, though it's expensive" jechuudha. 5) "politics" jechuun qindaa hammaa; "policy" jechuun qindaa tokko tokko. Afaan Oromo "siyasaa" jechuun lamaa qabda, akkas ummi.

title: Discussing Budgets and Investments / Budajetoon fi mirkaneen dubbifama
bridge: Ingliffa keessatti, duuka qajeelfama kana malee qajeelfama lafa qabeenyaa ta’ee akka qajeelfama ta’u godhaa malee qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis hin ta’in, duuka qajeelfama irra deebisu akkamitti wajjin tokko tokko dha. Fakkeenyaaf, ‘spend’ jedhanii duuka qajeelfama irra deebisu akkamitti himatanis ta’e malee ‘invest’ jedhanii duuka qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’e. Afaan Oromoo keessatti, ‘mirkaneen’ jedhaniin qajeelfama ta’u godhaa malee qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’e, Ingliffa keessatti ‘invest’ jedhaniin duuka qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’e. Akkasumas, Ingliffa keessatti kun duuka qajeelfama akkamitti himatanis ta’u godhaa malee qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’u akkamitti wajjin tokko tokko dha: ‘invest in’, ‘spend on’, ‘pay for’. Afaan Oromoo keessatti, wajjin kun hin kennamne garuu Ingliffa keessatti akkas hin taane. Wajjin kuni akkamitti himatanis ta’u akkamitti qabnaa ta’u barbaaduu dhaqqabaa.
rule: Budajetoon fi mirkaneen dubbifama B2 sirrii keessatti, duuka qajeelfama fi wajjin tokko tokko dhaqqabaa ta’u barbaaduu dha. Duuka qajeelfamaatiin: ‘earn’, ‘save’, ‘spend’, ‘invest’, ‘borrow’, ‘lend’, ‘owe’, ‘pay off’, ‘set aside’. Duuka qajeelfama kuni walitti wajjin tokko tokko dha: ‘earn money from’, ‘save up for’, ‘spend on’, ‘invest in’, ‘borrow from’, ‘lend to’. Duuka qajeelfamaatiin: ‘budget’, ‘expenses’, ‘income’, ‘savings’, ‘debt’, ‘interest rate’, ‘stock market’, ‘investment portfolio’. Sirrii lamaa keessatti qajeelfama ta’u godhaa malee qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’u akkamitti wajjin tokko tokko dha. Fakkeenyaaf, ‘I save 10% of my income’ (Sirrii lamaa keessatti qajeelfama ta’u godhaa), ‘Have you ever invested in stocks?’ (Sirrii lamaa keessatti qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’u). Akkamiiwwan sirrii lamaa keessatti qajeelfama ta’u godhaa malee qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’u akkamitti wajjin tokko tokko dha. ‘Lend’ fi ‘borrow’ jedhanii akkamiiwwan sirrii lamaa keessatti qajeelfama ta’u godhaa malee qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’u akkamitti wajjin tokko tokko dha: ‘lend’ jedhanii duuka qajeelfama ta’u godhaa, ‘borrow’ jedhanii duuka qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’e. Afaan Oromoo keessatti, ‘mirkaneen’ jedhaniin qajeelfama ta’u godhaa malee qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’e, Ingliffa keessatti ‘debt’ jedhaniin duuka qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’e. ‘Money’ jedhaniin duuka qajeelfama ta’u hin godhin walitti himatanis ta’e, ‘moneys’ hin jedhu.

title: Expressing Abstract Ideas and Nuance / Gaaffiiwwan wal qorophiiwwan ajajaa
bridge: Afaan Oromoo keessatti, gaaffiiwwan wal qorophiiwwan ajajaa dhaabbolaa subjuntiivoo fi lafa ‘dhaabbolaa’ kana malee ‘dhugeeffadhaa’ jechuun akka ta’ee itti fufi malee. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, gaaffiiwwan wal qorophiiwwan ajajaa qajeelfama kana biraa fi qorophiiwwan ajajaa godhamuu dhaabbolaa barbaachisaa fi lafa ‘it seems that’ kana ‘it is possible that’ jechuun barbaaddaa. Akkasumas, ‘actually’ (dhaabbolaa) fi ‘realize’ (dhaabbolaa) jechuun barbaaddaa. Akkasumas, ‘suggest’ fi ‘recommend’ + ‘that’ + lafa baay’ee (verbo en forma base) barbaaddaa.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti gaaffiiwwan wal qorophiiwwan ajajaa godhamuuf, haa ta’e kanarraa: 1. Barbaachisaa fi qorophiiwwan ajajaa godhamuu: ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘may’, ‘must’, ‘can’t’. 2. Lafa ‘it’ + ‘seems’, ‘is said’, ‘is believed’ jechuun. 3. Qorophiiwwan ajajaa godhamuu: ‘apparently’, ‘presumably’, ‘totally’, ‘completely’. 4. ‘Actually’ (dhaabbolaa) fi ‘currently’ (dhaabbolaa) jechuun. 5. ‘Realize’ (dhaabbolaa) jechuun. 6. ‘Suggest’ fi ‘recommend’ + ‘that’ + lafa baay’ee (verbo en forma base) jechuun. 7. ‘Would’ + lafa baay’ee (verbo en forma base) jechuun.

title: Discussing Art and Culture / Arte, cultura i historia garaa malee
bridge: Afan Oromo, baqalaa hojii fi baqalaa hojii qabaa miti gaafataa kan ta’ee jiruuf jechuun qaba. Ingiliziffam, 'present perfect' (have seen) guyyaa miti gaafataa fi wal fakkaatuu barbaachisaa ta’ee jiruuf jechuun qaba. 'Past simple' guyyaa miti gaafataa baqalaa hojii qabaa akakaa ta’ee jiruuf jechuun qaba. Fakkaatuu akakaa: Ingiliziffam, ajjeefamootaa akka ‘amazing, stunning’ jechuu kan ta’ee jiru, ajjeefamootaa baqalaa hojii (amazing, stunning) ajjeefamootaa baqalaa hojii akakaa (beautiful, old) irra deebi’an. Ingiliziffam, ‘the’ jechuun qabdu kan itti himan ama kan argaman ta’ee jiruuf jechuun qaba, Afaan Oromoos garuu, akkasuma hin qabnu.
rule:
Ingiliziffam B2 ta’e garaa malee arte fi culturaa garaa malee, kunimmoo qaban: 
- Baqalaa hojii ajjeefamootaa ta’ee jiruuf jechuun qabdu: 'The painting depicts...'
- Baqalaa hojii qabaa ta’ee jiruuf jechuun qabdu: 'I have visited the Prado Museum.'
- Baqalaa hojii qabaa akakaa ta’ee jiruuf jechuun qabdu: 'She painted this in 1990.'
- Ajjeefamootaa: ajjeefamootaa akakaa (ajjeefamootaa, hojii, qabaa, hojii, qabaa) fi ‘so’ fi ‘such’ jechuun qabdu.
- Ajjeefamootaa: 'In my view...', 'It strikes me as...'
- Verbos modales: 'It might be a fake.', 'It could represent freedom.'

title: Problem-solving discussions / Fiixee muddee guddaan kennaman
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, lafa qorophii kennaman guddaa fi suuraa ‘haa qorophaa’ jechuu akkas jechuuf godhan isaanii argachuu dha. Afaan Ingiliziiwwan, garuu, suuraa moddaalee fi kondishanaalee qorophii akkas jechuuf godhan isaanii argachuu dha. Akkasumas, afaan Ingiliziiwwan ‘should’ fi ‘ought to’ godhan isaanii argachuu dha akkasumas afaan Oromootti ‘dhaqaa’ jechuu akkas jechuuf godhan isaanii argachuu dha. Kondishanaalotaa fi ‘would’ suuraa kennaman guddaa keessatti argachuu dha.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii B2 irra deebii kennaman guddaa fi lafa qorophii kennaman guddaa godhan isaanii argachuu dha: 
1. **Kondishanaalaa lamaansaa** (hipootetikii): 'If + lamaan qabeessa, would + suuraa qabeessa'. Fakkeenya: 'If we had more time, we could finish the project.' Kana maleesuudha. 
2. **Kondishanaalaa sadii** (lamaan hipootetikii): 'If + lamaan qabeessee dubbii, would have + suuraa qabeessee dubbii'. Fakkeenya: 'If we had known earlier, we would have solved it.' Kana maleesuudha. 
3. **Moddaalaa lafa qorophii**: 'should', 'ought to', 'had better' + suuraa qabeessa. 'Had better' dhaabbataa akkasumas godhan isaanii argachuu dha. 
4. **Seenaa lafa qorophii**: 'What about...?', 'How about...?', 'Why don't we...?', 'Could we...?', 'Maybe we should...'. 
5. **Seenaa lafa qorophii**: 'On the one hand... on the other hand...', 'The advantage is...', 'The downside is...', 'It might work because...'. 
6. **Guddisuudha fi guddisuudha**: 'I see your point, but...', 'That sounds reasonable, however...', 'I'm not convinced that...'. 
‘Would’ suuraa ‘if’ keessatti argachuu dha (dhaabbataa afaan Oromootti).

title: Talking about Goals and Ambitions / Gaaffii fi Baay’ee Keessan Gadaa
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessatti, guyyaa lamaa ala ta’ee qabduudhaan (qabduudha + amanti) gaaffii keessan gadaa barbaachisuun barbaachina. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti garuu, ‘I’m planning to’, ‘I intend to’ ykn ‘will’ barbaachisuu dha. ‘Would like’ (dhaabbata kana malee) barbaachisuu dha. Kanarraa, gerund (-ing) preposition fi lamaa qorattoota ‘look forward to’ barbaachisuu dha. Afaan Oromo keessatti amanti barbaachisuu dha.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti gaaffii fi baay’ee keessan gadaa barbaachisuu dandeenya: 1) ‘be going to + amanti’ gaaffii fi baay’ee keessan gadaa (I’m going to start a business). 2) ‘will + amanti’ gaaffii fi baay’ee keessan gadaa (I’ll do my best). 3) ‘would like + amanti’ ykn ‘would love + amanti’ dhaabbata (I’d like to improve my English). 4) ‘hope’, ‘plan’, ‘intend’, ‘expect’ + amanti (I hope to travel, I plan to save money). 5) Gerund preposition keessatti: ‘look forward to + -ing’, ‘be interested in + -ing’. 6) Kondishinali lamaa tokkoo: ‘If I study hard, I’ll pass the exam’. Akkasumas, ‘to’ amanti keessatti barbaachisuu dha, gerund preposition keessatti barbaachisuu dha, ‘will’ fi lamaa ta’ee qabduudhaan barbaachisuu dha. ‘Hope’ lamaa ta’ee qabduudhaan barbaachisuu dha (I hope I get the job).
